title: What if sharks could walk on land?

bubbles.text: Here we observe... the land shark.
bubbles.name: Narrator

bubbles.text: I'm not wide. The DOOR is narrow.
bubbles.name: Hank

beats.caption: but one shark was *already* doing it

bubbles.text: The epaulette shark. Always been a walker.
bubbles.name: Narrator

stickers.text: Epaulette sharks walk on their fins & last ~2 h out of water 🦈
stickers.title: REAL FACT

bubbles.text: Do not. Put a foot. Down.
bubbles.name: Narrator

bubbles.text: And here... the rare human. In its natural habitat.
bubbles.name: Sir Finnegan

tags: what if sharks could walk on land
meta.description:
Sharks can walk now. One's late for work, one can't fit on the bus, and one is the lifeguard. 🦈🚶

Which shark would YOU want as a neighbour? 👇
